latin: Diffinitiones substantiarum naturalium, materiam non dicunt nisi consecutiue.
translation: Definitions of natural substances signify matter only consecutively, not directly.
translation_note: 'Consecutiue' (consecutively): matter enters the definition only as a consequence of the form defined, not as a distinct defining term (farmer1998:13175).
